senses.gloss: गोण गोण, अस्, m. an ox (fr. the Pāli).

गोणिक गोणिक, a kind of woollen clot
(fr. the Pāli गोणक).

गोणी गोणी, f. (at the end of an adj. comp.
गोणि), a sack; the measure of a Droṇa; torn or
ragged clothes; [cf. गौणिक.]
—गोणी-तरी, f. a
small sack.

गोण्ड गोण्ड, अस्, m. a fleshy navel; a per-
son with a fleshy or prominent navel; a man of a
low tribe, a mountaineer, especially inhabiting the
eastern portion of the Vindhya range between the
Narbadā and Kistna, giving name to the province
of Gondvana.
—गोण्ड-वन, अम्, n. the Goṇḍa
forest, N. of a country; (also गोण्डवार.)

गोण्डकिरी गोण्डकिरी or गोण्डाक्री, f., N. of
a Rāgiṇī.
